description: Read the speech-to-text transcript started by transcriptlab_transcribe_file (pass upload_id) or transcriptlab_transcribe_media_url (pass media_id). Pass exactly one id. While transcription runs it returns a pending result: wait a few seconds, back off, and stop after about ten tries; if it is still pending, tell the user the job is queued instead of looping. Reading does not start new work or add charges.
name: transcriptlab_get_speech_transcript
title: Read a speech-to-text transcript
